cases.name: Monica Elaine Sykes
cases.narrative: On 2/4/2017, her remains were found scattered by animals. He shot her in the back of the head. He dragged her body into a field and then enlisted the help of his brother to burn a car to destroy evidence, prosecutors alleged. Her remains were found scattered by animals.
